text: I can compare active-passive, home-region active-active and multi-writer active-active, and compute RPO and per-region headroom for each.
I can work out the commit latency of a cross-region consensus write from region RTTs and leader placement.
I can walk through a split-brain write under last-writer-wins and show which write is lost and why clock skew matters.
I can choose LWW, a CRDT, application merge or single-writer ownership for a given field and explain the invariant that decides it.
I can design a residency-compliant layout with home regions and a PII-free global directory, and list the secondary copies that can leak data.
I can explain how GeoDNS, latency-based DNS and anycast route users and why DNS failover leaves a straggler tail.
